answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150121 Country: India Title: I would like to know if TEHZEEB name is ok in Islam for a baby girl. Also please tell me the meaning of it. Question: I would like to know if TEHZEEB name is ok in Islam for a baby girl. Also please tell me the meaning of it. Answer ID: 150121 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 582/455/D=7/1438) Tehzeeb means: Orderliness, good manners, civility. You may keep this name for your daughter, it is good name. However, it is advisable to name after the Holy Wives or Holy Daughters of the Prophet, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon them all, and after the pious women who have passed earlier such as Khadijah, Kulsum, Umm Habibah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
